summary: Compared the raw extract and all changed wiki passages citing the guide against the supplied full article text. I found three overstatements about Codex models being trained with, or post-trained on, a complete harness; the raw extract also notes that hidden page content was not reviewed.

findings.claim: The page says the model was trained with the recommended system prompt and the `shell` and `update_plan` tools, but the article only says it was trained to excel at the `apply_patch` diff format.
findings.evidence: The article says, “We strongly recommend using our exact `apply_patch` implementation as the model has been trained to excel at this diff format,” then separately recommends `shell` and `update_plan` (codex_guide.md:212). It describes the prompt as optimized against internal evals, not as training data (codex_guide.md:37).

findings.claim: The heading generalizes from specific Codex recommendations to the claim that models are trained on a particular harness.
findings.evidence: The article recommends starting from its Codex-Max prompt and updating tools to improve performance (codex_guide.md:32-33), but only makes a specific training claim about `apply_patch` (codex_guide.md:212). It also cautions that models “ha[ve]n’t necessarily been post-trained to excel” at other custom tools (codex_guide.md:539).

findings.claim: The statement that some models are post-trained with their own harness, using OpenAI’s guide as an example, attributes a training claim to the guide that it does not make.
findings.evidence: The guide recommends its prompt and tools when migrating a harness (codex_guide.md:30-33), but does not say Codex was post-trained with the complete codex-cli harness; its explicit training statements concern following AGENTS.md (codex_guide.md:180) and the `apply_patch` diff format (codex_guide.md:212).

questions: The extract says 8 hidden elements totaling about 9.9k characters were not reviewed (raw/articles/2026-10-09-openai-codex-prompting-guide.md:12-13); could content in those elements affect completeness?
